name: Resy
description: Resy makes it easy to discover and book restaurant reservations across the United States. Just share what you're looking for, and instantly browse top restaurants, check real-time availability, and secure a table in seconds. Whether it's a last-minute dinner or a special night out, Resy helps you get a seat at the places you love.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Resy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Resy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://apigw.americanexpress.com/dining/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Resy?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Resy in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Resy requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Resy is developed by Resy. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
